target: Formal levels 4-100 reorder proposal; levels 1-3 remain unchanged.

algorithm.name: ascending-average shifted local spike
algorithm.description: Sort levels by complexityScore ascending. For each 4-level block, assign three setup levels from the remaining low-to-high pool, then assign a challenge level from a slightly higher score rank. Keep the highest-scored level as the final level 100 peak.
